primary_goal: prevent nested component-preset fields from being silently coerced, dropped, or serialized only to fail later
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

scope.operator: ComponentPresetCatalog nested record parser and create/update mutation parser
scope.phase: sources, scalar fields, component/port metadata, aliases, and persistence serialization
scope.trigger: unknown or non-string sources, non-finite metadata, scalar coercion, or conflicting aliases/wrapper fields

problem_domain_closure.sources: strict field set and string values for persisted records and create/update
problem_domain_closure.scalar_fields: strict types for persisted records and create/update where coercion could lose meaning
problem_domain_closure.metadata: open extension keys retained, but unsupported/non-finite values rejected before save
problem_domain_closure.aliases: conflicting id/preset_id, component/component_spec, and preset wrapper fields rejected
problem_domain_closure.json_boundary: HTTP NaN is rejected as bad_json before mutation validation
problem_domain_closure.compatibility: single aliases and ignored detail fields remain accepted

data_roles.comparison: direct Catalog and HTTP status/code outcomes
data_roles.holdout: metadata NaN direct call, HTTP JSON NaN, alias conflicts, and valid extension metadata

guardrails: keep metadata keys open for forward-compatible extensions
reject unsupported values before atomic save
preserve H13 persistence error envelope and H14 top-level schema checks
preserve valid CRUD and single-alias compatibility
run clean .venv full suite before promotion
next_step: review any remaining canonicalization of source metadata and ignored mutation fields as an independent scope
